verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.ebanx.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 and contains an 'Instructions for LLM Agents' section. The llms.txt also advertises Agent Skills ('opinionated integration guidance for AI coding assistants'), and a dedicated ebanx-integration-prompt.txt provides agent-oriented docs for generating runnable sandbox code. missing for 10: detail on the scope and contents of the Agent Skills, and evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt) or independent user reports of agents using these files.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: EBANX provides Agent Skills — opinionated integration guidance for AI coding assistants.
help merchants generate accurate, runnable code snippets and setup instructions for integrating with the EBANX sandbox environment
